question: Reuse Drive-JEPA driving-video pretraining data and method for the current LPWM research
scope: Feasibility investigation; no new downloads, training jobs, or changes to registered training sources/configuration/queues
research_subquestion: Does broader self-supervised driving-video adaptation improve particle motion information available to intent-conditioned planning?

public_code_audit.loss: Masked target representation regression; encoder and predictor receive gradient, target encoder uses stop-gradient and EMA
public_code_audit.search_scope: README and tracked-looking py/yaml/yml/sh/md files in local checkout; absence is limited to inspected public assets
public_code_audit.generic_config_difference: 16 frames, 4Hz, square 256 crop, generic video datasets; not the driving-paper recipe
public_code_audit.caution: Spatiotemporal mask completion is not necessarily strictly past-to-future forecasting

available_checkpoint.role: Driving-domain ViT encoder checkpoint; cannot be directly loaded into the LPWM CNN/context/dynamics architecture

dataset_access.name: CoVLA
dataset_access.access: HF login, contact-information sharing and terms acceptance; current account approval not checked
dataset_access.terms_note: Academic/noncommercial dataset terms must be reviewed separately from software licensing

dataset_access.name: DrivingDojo
dataset_access.access: Gated HF repositories; account approval not checked
dataset_access.caution: Base repository size and license must not be presented as those of all shards

dataset_access.name: OpenScene trainval
dataset_access.availability: Some front-view continuous clips verified; local NAVSIM sensor subset does not cover every metadata frame

bounded_local_frame_audit.criterion: All eight CAM_F0 files exist, and each metadata interval lies between 0.4 and 0.6 seconds; windows overlap
bounded_local_frame_audit.caution: Small availability audit, not a statistical estimate of full corpus hours or image decoding validity

cpu_preprocessing_smoke.resize: RGB BICUBIC, feasibility only; exact paper crop protocol not established

constraints.note: Both GPUs already run existing experiments; paper H800 runtime cannot be transferred to this server

assessment.reuse_datasets: Yes, subject to access, training-only recording manifest and storage budgeting
assessment.reuse_exact_vjepa_recipe: Generic implementation is available; exact 330-hour curation/mixture/crop/training configuration remains unverified
assessment.reuse_for_lpwm: LPWM SSL on these videos is feasible after data loader/config changes; JEPA loss and ViT weights are not a drop-in replacement for particle SSL
assessment.teacher_option: Existing driving-pretrained encoder can be a frozen feature teacher; particle-to-feature alignment and gradient routing require new design and validation
assessment.recommended_first_step: Establish training-only continuous clip manifest from existing OpenScene images and compare driving-video SSL before planning under controlled downstream conditions
assessment.future_exclusion: Exclude evaluation recordings/adjacent frames from any locally curated adaptation corpus; audit rather than assume absence of overlap
assessment.fair_comparison: Report and control external pretraining exposure, camera/history/resolution, planner, batch and seed in register-versus-particle comparisons
